translations.literal: Loyal and Righteous 8
translations.idiomatic: Loyal and Righteous, Part 8

sentences.zh: 姚懷祥全福舒恭受等韋逢甲長喜等麥廷章劉大忠等

translations.literal: Yao Huaixiang, Quan Fu, Shu Gongshou, and others; Wei Fengjia, Chang Xi, and others; Mai Tingzhang, Liu Dazhong, and others
translations.idiomatic: Yao Huaixiang, Quan Fu, Shu Gongshou, and others; Wei Fengjia, Chang Xi, and others; Mai Tingzhang, Liu Dazhong, and others

sentences.zh: 韋印福錢金玉等龍汝元樂善魁霖等文豐

translations.literal: Wei Yinfu, Qian Jinyu, and others; Long Ruyuan, Yue Shan, Kui Lin, and others; Wen Feng
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yinfu, Qian Jinyu, and others; Long Ruyuan, Yue Shan, Kui Lin, and others; Wen Feng

sentences.zh: 殷明恆高騰雲等高善繼駱佩德等林永昇陳金揆等

translations.literal: Yin Mingheng, Gao Tengyun, and others; Gao Shanji, Luo Peide, and others; Lin Yongsheng, Chen Jinkui, and others
translations.idiomatic: Yin Mingheng, Gao Tengyun, and others; Gao Shanji, Luo Peide, and others; Lin Yongsheng, Chen Jinkui, and others

sentences.zh: 李大本於光炘等黃祖蓮

translations.literal: Li Daben, Yu Guangxin, and others; Huang Zulian
translations.idiomatic: Li Daben, Yu Guangxin, and others; Huang Zulian

sentences.zh: 姚懷祥，福建侯官人。

translations.literal: Yao Huaixiang was a native of Houguan, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Huaixiang was from Houguan in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶二十三年舉人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of the Jiaqing reign he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: He received his juren degree in the twenty-third year of Jiaqing (1818).

sentences.zh: 道光十五年，挑知縣，發浙江，權象山、龍遊等縣。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Daoguang he was selected as a magistrate and sent to Zhejiang, where he served in acting capacity at Xiangshan, Longyou, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Daoguang (1835) he was tapped for a county magistracy and posted to Zhejiang, where he acted as magistrate at Xiangshan, Longyou, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 二十年，英吉利以欽差大臣林則徐在兩廣堅持鴉片之禁，耀兵寧波洋面，破定海，旋退出。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, because Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu in Guangdong firmly upheld the opium prohibition, England displayed force off the Ningbo coast, took Dinghai, and then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1840), Britain—angered that Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu was enforcing the opium ban in Guangdong—showed force off the Ningbo coast, captured Dinghai, and soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月，攻虎門，廣東水師提督關天培、湖南提督祥福；

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, the second month, they attacked Humen: Guangdong naval commander Guan Tianpei and Hunan provincial commander Xiang Fu;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-first year (1841) they attacked Humen: Guangdong naval commander Guan Tianpei and Hunan provincial commander Xiang Fu;

sentences.zh: 七月，攻廈門，總兵江繼芸，游擊凌志；

translations.literal: the seventh month, Xiamen: commander Jiang Jiyun and regional commander Ling Zhi;
translations.idiomatic: in the seventh month, Xiamen: commander Jiang Jiyun and regional commander Ling Zhi;

sentences.zh: 八月，復攻定海，總兵王錫朋、鄭國鴻、葛雲飛；

translations.literal: the eighth month, Dinghai again: commanders Wang Xipeng, Zheng Guohong, and Ge Yunfei;
translations.idiomatic: in the eighth month, Dinghai again: commanders Wang Xipeng, Zheng Guohong, and Ge Yunfei;

sentences.zh: 九月，攻鎮海，兩江總督裕謙，狼山鎮總兵謝朝恩；

translations.literal: the ninth month, Zhenhai: Liangjiang governor Yu Qian and Langshan garrison commander Xie Chao'en;
translations.idiomatic: in the ninth month, Zhenhai: Liangjiang governor Yu Qian and Langshan garrison commander Xie Chao'en;

sentences.zh: 二十二年三月，攻慈溪，副將硃貴與子昭南；

translations.literal: the twenty-second year, third month, Cixi: deputy commander Zhu Gui and his son Zhaonan;
translations.idiomatic: in the third month of the twenty-second year (1842), Cixi: deputy commander Zhu Gui and his son Zhaonan;

sentences.zh: 五月，攻吳淞，江南提督陳化成：均先後殉難，自有傳。

translations.literal: the fifth month, Wusong: Jiangnan commander Chen Huacheng: all died one after another in succession; each has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: in the fifth month, Wusong: Jiangnan commander Chen Huacheng—all died in turn; each has a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 懷祥於二十年適署定海篆，分募鄉勇，為死守計，總兵張朝發撤之。

translations.literal: Huaixiang happened in the twentieth year to be acting magistrate of Dinghai, recruited militia in separate groups, and planned a defense to the death; Commander Zhang Chaofa disbanded them.
translations.idiomatic: In that same twentieth year Huaixiang was acting magistrate of Dinghai. He raised local militia in detachments for a last-ditch defense, but Commander Zhang Chaofa disbanded them.

sentences.zh: 城陷南門，懷祥負傷，立城上呼兵，無應者，憤甚，投成仁塘死。

translations.literal: When the city fell at the south gate, Huaixiang was wounded, stood atop the wall calling for troops, and when none answered was furious and threw himself into Chengren Pond to die.
translations.idiomatic: When the south gate fell he was wounded, stood on the wall calling for troops, and when no one came leapt into Chengren Pond in rage and died.

sentences.zh: 典史全福使酒仗氣，敵至，衣冠坐獄門。

translations.literal: Archivist Quan Fu was given to wine and bluster; when the enemy arrived he sat at the prison gate in full dress.
translations.idiomatic: Archivist Quan Fu was a drinker with a swaggering temper; when the enemy came he sat at the prison gate in cap and gown.

sentences.zh: 囚跳，歎曰：「失城當死。

translations.literal: A prisoner leaped out; he sighed and said, "Losing the city deserves death.
translations.idiomatic: A prisoner broke loose. He sighed: "Losing the city means death.

sentences.zh: 況失囚耶？

translations.literal: How much more losing prisoners?
translations.idiomatic: How much more when prisoners escape?

sentences.zh: 」敵入署，大呼殺賊，斃黑酋者一，叢刺死。

translations.literal: " When the enemy entered the yamen he shouted to kill the bandits, killed one black chieftain, and was run through in a cluster of spears.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy entered the yamen he roared to kill the invaders, felled one black chieftain, and was stabbed to death in a hail of spears.

sentences.zh: 翌年，再犯寧波、定海，則石浦同知舒恭受，游擊張玉衡、外委武英太同死難。

translations.literal: The next year, when Ningbo and Dinghai were attacked again, Subprefect Shu Gongshou of Shipu, regional commander Zhang Yuheng, and staff officer Wu Yingtai all died together.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when Ningbo and Dinghai were struck again, Shipu subprefect Shu Gongshou, regional commander Zhang Yuheng, and staff officer Wu Yingtai all died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 都司李躍淵則隨總兵鄭國鴻戰曉峰嶺六晝夜，與把總胡大純、洪武琮，外委金釗同歿於陣。

translations.literal: Bureau director Li Yueyuan followed Commander Zheng Guohong at Xiaofeng Ridge for six days and nights of battle and fell in the field together with company commander Hu Dachun, Hu Hongcong, and staff officer Jin Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Bureau director Li Yueyuan fought six days and nights with Commander Zheng Guohong on Xiaofeng Ridge and fell with company commanders Hu Dachun and Hu Hongcong and staff officer Jin Zhao.

sentences.zh: 是役也，慈溪大寶山死者，為即用知縣顏履敬，參將黃泰，守備田錫、陳芝蘭、徐宦、哈克里，千總阿本穰、魏啟明，把總林懷玉、盧炳、邸法德，外委張化鵬、馬龍圖、何海、毛玉貴、王保元、楊福增；

translations.literal: In that campaign, those who died at Dabaoshan in Cixi were acting magistrate Yan Lujing, brigade commander Huang Tai, garrison commanders Tian Xi, Chen Zhilan, Xu Huan, and Hake Li, battalion commanders Abenrang and Wei Qiming, company commanders Lin Huaiyu, Lu Bing, and Di Fade, and staff officers Zhang Huapeng, Ma Longtu, He Hai, Mao Yugui, Wang Baoyuan, and Yang Fuzeng;
translations.idiomatic: In that battle the dead at Dabaoshan in Cixi included acting magistrate Yan Lujing, brigade commander Huang Tai, garrison commanders Tian Xi, Chen Zhilan, Xu Huan, and Hake Li, battalion commanders Abenrang and Wei Qiming, company commanders Lin Huaiyu, Lu Bing, and Di Fade, and staff officers Zhang Huapeng, Ma Longtu, He Hai, Mao Yugui, Wang Baoyuan, and Yang Fuzeng;

sentences.zh: 死鎮海城者，為縣丞李向陽；

translations.literal: Those who died in Zhenhai city were assistant magistrate Li Xiangyang;
translations.idiomatic: Those who fell in Zhenhai city were assistant magistrate Li Xiangyang;

sentences.zh: 戰金雞山死者，為都司孫汝鵬，守備李雲龍、王萬龍，千總陳慶三、陳守澍、周萬治，把總馬金龍、汪宗斌、解天培、金，外委林賡、吳定江；

translations.literal: those who died fighting at Jinjishan were bureau director Sun Rupeng, garrison commanders Li Yunlong and Wang Wanlong, battalion commanders Chen Qingsan, Chen Shoushu, and Zhou Wanzhi, company commanders Ma Jinlong, Wang Zongbin, and Xie Tianpei, Jin, and staff officers Lin Geng and Wu Dingjiang;
translations.idiomatic: at Jinjishan, bureau director Sun Rupeng, garrison commanders Li Yunlong and Wang Wanlong, battalion commanders Chen Qingsan, Chen Shoushu, and Zhou Wanzhi, company commanders Ma Jinlong, Wang Zongbin, and Xie Tianpei, Jin, and staff officers Lin Geng and Wu Dingjiang;

sentences.zh: 死招寶山者，為外委蔡步高。

translations.literal: those who died at Zhaobaoshan were staff officer Cai Bugao.
translations.idiomatic: at Zhaobaoshan, staff officer Cai Bugao.

sentences.zh: 而山陰練勇袁樂忠以從間道導硃貴軍至長碕迎戰，為砲火所逼，從煙焰中躍起，投海死。

translations.literal: Shanyin militiaman Yuan Lezhong guided Zhu Gui's force by a side path to Changqi to give battle; pressed by gunfire he leapt from the smoke and flame into the sea and died.
translations.idiomatic: Shanyin militiaman Yuan Lezhong led Zhu Gui's troops by a bypath to Changqi to fight; driven by cannon fire he sprang from the smoke into the sea and drowned.

sentences.zh: 韋逢甲，山東​​齊河人。

translations.literal: Wei Fengjia was a native of Qihe, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Fengjia was from Qihe in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 道光十六年進士，用知縣，發浙江，累權宣平、馀杭、浦江等縣。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Daoguang he passed the metropolitan examination, was appointed magistrate, sent to Zhejiang, and repeatedly acted at Xuanping, Yuhang, Pujiang, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of Daoguang (1836) he became a jinshi, received a magistracy, was posted to Zhejiang, and repeatedly acted at Xuanping, Yuhang, Pujiang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 英吉利既再擾寧波洋面，將寇吳淞，先以弋船三十艘進攻乍浦。

translations.literal: After England again disturbed the Ningbo coast and was about to threaten Wusong, it first sent thirty light gunboats to attack Zhapu.
translations.idiomatic: When Britain again harassed the Ningbo coast and prepared to threaten Wusong, it first sent thirty light gunboats against Zhapu.

sentences.zh: 時逢甲以督鑄大砲，由鎮海赴乍浦設防，就權同知。

translations.literal: At that time Fengjia was supervising the casting of great guns, went from Zhenhai to Zhapu to set defenses, and took acting subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: Fengjia was then overseeing the casting of heavy guns, went from Zhenhai to Zhapu to fortify the place, and served as acting subprefect.

sentences.zh: 四月，敵遽由東光山上陸，屯兵皆潰。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the enemy suddenly landed from Dongguang Hill; the encamped troops all broke.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the enemy landed suddenly from Dongguang Hill and the encamped troops scattered.

sentences.zh: 逢甲帶鄉團禦於西行汛，死之。

translations.literal: Fengjia led local militia to defend at the west-line post and died there.
translations.idiomatic: Fengjia led local militia to hold the west-line post and was killed.

sentences.zh: 同死者，為駐防副都統長喜，前鋒協領英登布，佐領隆福，防禦貴順、額特赫，前鋒校佛印，驍騎校伊勒哈畚、根順、該杭阿及調浙助防之守備張淮泗，千總李廷貴，把總王榮、馬致榮、孫登霄，外委馬成功、硃朝貴。

translations.literal: Those who died with him were garrison deputy commander Chang Xi, vanguard assistant commandant Ying Dengbu, assistant commandant Long Fu, defense officers Guishun and Etehe, vanguard corporal Foyin, brave-rider corporals Yilehaben, Genshun, and Gaihang'a, and the transferred Zhejiang reinforcements garrison commander Zhang Huaisi, battalion commander Li Tinggui, company commanders Wang Rong, Ma Zhirong, and Sun Dengxiao, and staff officers Ma Chenggong and Zhu Chaogui.
translations.idiomatic: He was joined in death by garrison deputy commander Chang Xi, vanguard assistant commandant Ying Dengbu, assistant commandant Long Fu, defense officers Guishun and Etehe, vanguard corporal Foyin, brave-rider corporals Yilehaben, Genshun, and Gaihang'a, and reinforcements sent from elsewhere—garrison commander Zhang Huaisi, battalion commander Li Tinggui, company commanders Wang Rong, Ma Zhirong, and Sun Dengxiao, and staff officers Ma Chenggong and Zhu Chaogui.

sentences.zh: 而伊勒哈畚尤慘，伏觀山射夷，殪甚眾，被執，磔死。

translations.literal: Yilehaben's end was especially grim: lying in ambush on Guanshan he shot the foreigners and killed many; captured, he was dismembered.
translations.idiomatic: Yilehaben's fate was especially grim: ambushed on Guanshan he shot down many invaders, was taken alive, and dismembered.

sentences.zh: 子仁厚，襲職，殉粵寇。

translations.literal: His son Renhou inherited the post and died fighting the Cantonese rebels.
translations.idiomatic: His son Renhou inherited the office and later died fighting the Taiping rebels in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 麥廷章，廣東鶴山人。

translations.literal: Mai Tingzhang was a native of Heshan, Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Mai Tingzhang was from Heshan in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 道光十二年，以外委隨剿連州瑤匪功，屢遷至游擊。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Daoguang, as a staff officer he followed the campaign against the Yao bandits of Lianzhou and was repeatedly promoted to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Daoguang (1832) he entered service as a staff officer in the campaign against the Yao of Lianzhou and rose by repeated promotion to regional commander.

sentences.zh: 林則徐查辦英吉利躉船鴉片，檄廷章率舟師駐九龍山巡防。

translations.literal: When Lin Zexu investigated English opium receiving ships, he ordered Tingzhang to lead naval forces stationed at Jiulongshan on patrol.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin Zexu investigated British opium receiving ships, he ordered Tingzhang to lead a flotilla on patrol at Jiulongshan.

sentences.zh: 英酋遞書辯論，開導不服，遽開砲，廷章以大砲應之，毀雙桅敵船。

translations.literal: The English chief sent letters arguing; persuasion failed and they suddenly opened fire; Tingzhang answered with great guns and destroyed a two-masted enemy ship.
translations.idiomatic: The British commander sent letters to argue the point; when persuasion failed they opened fire. Tingzhang replied with heavy guns and destroyed a two-masted enemy vessel.

sentences.zh: 又潛約土密兵船助攻，复擊卻之。

translations.literal: He also secretly arranged native craft to assist the attack and again beat them off.
translations.idiomatic: He also secretly coordinated local craft for a joint attack and drove them off again.

sentences.zh: 英人既陷浙定海，遂溯大洋至天津乞和，朝命直隸總督琦善馳粵與議，海防遽懈。

translations.literal: After the English had taken Dinghai in Zhejiang they sailed the great ocean to Tianjin to sue for peace; the court ordered Zhili governor Qishan to hurry to Guangdong to negotiate, and coastal defense was suddenly relaxed.
translations.idiomatic: After the British took Dinghai in Zhejiang they sailed to Tianjin to sue for peace; the court sent Zhili governor Qishan to Guangdong to negotiate, and coastal defenses slackened at once.

sentences.zh: 二十年十二月，敵乘不備，突進占大角、沙角，廷章時佐提督關天培防守靖遠砲台。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twentieth year the enemy, taking advantage of unpreparedness, suddenly advanced and seized Dajiao and Shajiao; Tingzhang was then assisting Commander Guan Tianpei in defending Jingyuan Battery.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the twentieth year (1840) the enemy, catching the coast unready, seized Dajiao and Shajiao; Tingzhang was then assisting Commander Guan Tianpei at Jingyuan Battery.

sentences.zh: 明年二月，敵船擁入三門口，斷防禦椿練。

translations.literal: In the second month of the next year enemy ships crowded into Sanmenkou and cut the defensive piles and chains.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the following year enemy ships crowded into Sanmenkou and severed the defensive booms and chains.

sentences.zh: 南風作，復以大隊圍橫檔、永安，截我軍援道，進犯虎門。

translations.literal: When the south wind rose they again surrounded Hengdang and Yong'an in force, cut our relief routes, and advanced on Humen.
translations.idiomatic: When the south wind rose they surrounded Hengdang and Yong'an in strength, cut our relief routes, and pressed on Humen.

sentences.zh: 廷章奮勇御之，力竭死。

translations.literal: Tingzhang fought them fiercely and died when his strength was spent.
translations.idiomatic: Tingzhang fought them fiercely until his strength gave out and he died.

sentences.zh: 時同死者，為香山協副將劉大忠，游擊沈佔鼇，守備洪達科等。

translations.literal: Those who died with him at the time were Xiangshan assistant deputy commander Liu Dazhong, regional commander Shen Zhan'ao, garrison commander Hong Dake, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Those who fell with him included Xiangshan assistant deputy commander Liu Dazhong, regional commander Shen Zhan'ao, garrison commander Hong Dake, and others.

sentences.zh: 參將周枋則以拒敵烏湧戰歿。

translations.literal: Brigade commander Zhou Fang died fighting the enemy at Wuyong.
translations.idiomatic: Brigade commander Zhou Fang was killed resisting the enemy at Wuyong.

sentences.zh: 三月，英人復由粵擾閩，攻廈門，犯內港，守備王世俊、蔣錫恩，千總張然迎擊之，均以力戰陣亡。

translations.literal: In the third month the English again from Guangdong disturbed Fujian, attacked Xiamen, and violated the inner harbor; garrison commanders Wang Shijun and Jiang Xi'en and battalion commander Zhang Ran met them and all died fighting in the field.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the British again moved from Guangdong against Fujian, attacked Xiamen, and penetrated the inner harbor; garrison commanders Wang Shijun and Jiang Xi'en and battalion commander Zhang Ran met them and all died in battle.

sentences.zh: 韋印福，江蘇上元人。

translations.literal: Wei Yinfu was a native of Shangyuan, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yinfu was from Shangyuan in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 由行伍隨剿滑縣匪，有膽略，嘗曰：「武官臨陣，死生度外事，畏死不作武官矣。

translations.literal: From the ranks he followed the campaign against bandits in Huaxian; he had daring and once said, "For a military officer in battle, life and death are outside consideration; if one fears death one should not be a military officer.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from the ranks in the campaign against bandits in Huaxian. Bold and outspoken, he once said: "For a military officer on the battlefield, life and death are beside the point—if you fear death, do not be a military officer.

sentences.zh: 」累擢千總，為兩江總督陶澍所賞，擢署金山營游擊。

translations.literal: " He was repeatedly promoted to battalion commander, was prized by Liangjiang governor Tao Shu, and was promoted to acting regional commander of the Jinshan garrison.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted repeatedly to battalion commander, won favor from Liangjiang governor Tao Shu, and was elevated to acting regional commander of the Jinshan garrison.

sentences.zh: 英吉利之窺吳淞也，提督陳化成守西砲台，誓死戰，以印福忠勇，隸左右。

translations.literal: When England was watching Wusong, Commander Chen Huacheng held the west battery and vowed to fight to the death; because Yinfu was loyal and brave, he was kept at his side.
translations.idiomatic: When Britain threatened Wusong, Commander Chen Huacheng held the west battery and swore to fight to the death; Yinfu, judged loyal and brave, was kept at his side.

sentences.zh: 二十二年五月，敵艦叢擊之，化成被傷，印福救護不及，歿於陣。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twenty-second year enemy ships concentrated their fire; Huacheng was wounded and Yinfu could not save him in time and died in the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twenty-second year (1842) enemy ships concentrated their fire. Huacheng was wounded; Yinfu could not reach him in time and died in the line.

sentences.zh: 化成之歿，從殉者八十人，其尤烈者：千總錢金玉，臨危或勸避去，答曰：「金玉年十六即食國餉，今焉避？

translations.literal: When Huacheng died, eighty men followed him in death; among the most resolute was battalion commander Qian Jinyu, whom some at the crisis urged to withdraw; he answered, "Jinyu has eaten the state's pay since sixteen—why withdraw now?
translations.idiomatic: When Huacheng fell, eighty men died with him. Among the most resolute was battalion commander Qian Jinyu; at the crisis some urged him to withdraw. He answered: "I have drawn the state's pay since I was sixteen—why should I withdraw now?

sentences.zh: 」遂及難；

translations.literal: Thus he met disaster;
translations.idiomatic: He perished likewise;

sentences.zh: 外委徐太華，善用砲，轉移如志，擊皆命中，被擊死；

translations.literal: staff officer Xu Taihua was skilled with guns, shifted them as he wished, and every shot hit; he was struck and killed;
translations.idiomatic: staff officer Xu Taihua was a master gunner who shifted his pieces at will and never missed; he was struck down;

sentences.zh: 把總許攀桂，擁護化成，謂：「主將與某等同甘苦，公報國在今日，某等報公亦在今日！

translations.literal: company commander Xu Pangui shielded Huacheng and said, "The commander-in-chief and we share hardship alike; the lord repays the state today, and we repay the lord today!
translations.idiomatic: company commander Xu Pangui shielded Huacheng and cried: "Our commander shares hardship with us—the general repays the state today, and we repay the general today!

sentences.zh: 」眾心益固，卒飲劍死；

translations.literal: Hearts grew firmer and in the end he drank the sword and died;
translations.idiomatic: Hearts steadied; in the end he took his own sword and died;

sentences.zh: 把總龔增齡，迎戰，刃數人，敵人圍而擒之，釘手足於板，擲諸海；

translations.literal: company commander Gong Zengling met the attack, blade in hand cut down several men; the enemy surrounded and seized him, nailed hands and feet to a board, and cast him into the sea;
translations.idiomatic: company commander Gong Zengling met the enemy blade in hand and cut down several men; they surrounded him, nailed his limbs to a plank, and threw him into the sea;

sentences.zh: 外委周林，率帳下巷戰，中槍，先化成死。

translations.literal: staff officer Zhou Lin led his men in lane fighting, was shot, and died before Huacheng.
translations.idiomatic: staff officer Zhou Lin led his men in close quarters, was shot, and died before Huacheng.

sentences.zh: 時督師兩江總督牛鑑，以砲毀演武廳，亟退去，之蘇州，又之江寧，敵遂由寶山徇上海，道以下官皆遁，典史劉慶恩投浦江死。

translations.literal: At the time the commander-in-chief Liangjiang governor Niu Jian, because cannon fire destroyed the drill hall, hurriedly withdrew to Suzhou and then to Jiangning; the enemy then from Baoshan pushed toward Shanghai; officials along the route all fled; archivist Liu Qing'en threw himself into the Pujiang and died.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Liangjiang governor Niu Jian, when cannon fire wrecked the drill hall, hurried off to Suzhou and then Jiangning; the enemy pushed from Baoshan toward Shanghai; officials along the route fled; archivist Liu Qing'en drowned himself in the Pujiang.

sentences.zh: 內河不能深入艦隊，乃由福山口犯鎮江京口，副都統海齡戰不勝，自縊死，尋諡昭節。

translations.literal: The inland river could not admit deep-draft fleets; they therefore entered by Fukou Hill to strike Zhenjiang Jingkou; deputy commander Hailing fought and could not win and hanged himself; he was soon given the posthumous title Zhaojie.
translations.idiomatic: Deep-draft fleets could not penetrate the inland waterways; the enemy entered by Fukou Hill against Zhenjiang Jingkou. Deputy commander Hailing fought, failed, and hanged himself, later receiving the posthumous title Zhaojie.

sentences.zh: 赴援游擊羅必魁、把總趙連璧，均死之。

translations.literal: Regional commander Luo Bikui and company commander Zhao Lianbi, who went to reinforce, both died.
translations.idiomatic: Regional commander Luo Bikui and company commander Zhao Lianbi, sent to reinforce, both died.

sentences.zh: 駐防員弁同與難者，為馬甲長松，與子驍騎校祥雲；

translations.literal: Garrison officers who died together were armored soldier Chang Song and his son brave-rider corporal Xiangyun;
translations.idiomatic: Garrison officers who perished with them included armored soldier Chang Song and his son, brave-rider corporal Xiangyun;

sentences.zh: 佐領景星、愛星布、𢗝明，防禦恆山、尚德、恆福、吉成，驍騎校伊克濟訥，文舉人噶喇，武舉人哈達海，筆帖式哈豐阿、恩喜，前鋒校松寶、文魁、阿勒金圖、喜興等。

translations.literal: assistant commandants Jingxing, Aixingbu, and Huiming, defense officers Hengshan, Shangde, Hengfu, and Jicheng, brave-rider corporal Yikejine, civil juren Gala, military juren Hadahai, clerks Hafeng'a and Enxi, and vanguard corporals Songbao, Wenkui, Alejintu, and Xixing, and others.
translations.idiomatic: assistant commandants Jingxing, Aixingbu, and Huiming; defense officers Hengshan, Shangde, Hengfu, and Jicheng; brave-rider corporal Yikejine; civil juren Gala; military juren Hadahai; clerks Hafeng'a and Enxi; vanguard corporals Songbao, Wenkui, Alejintu, and Xixing; and others.

sentences.zh: 迫江寧欽差大臣耆英等奏定款局，而五口通商之約成。

translations.literal: Pressed by Jiangning Imperial Commissioner Qiying and others who memorialized to fix the terms, the treaty of the five ports for trade was concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Under pressure from Jiangning Imperial Commissioner Qiying and others, who memorialized to settle terms, the treaty opening five ports to trade was concluded.

sentences.zh: 龍汝元，順天宛平人。

translations.literal: Long Ruyuan was a native of Wanping, Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Long Ruyuan was from Wanping in Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 由行伍隨剿廣西會匪，以功累擢游擊，隸河南巡撫英桂軍營。

translations.literal: From the ranks he followed the campaign against the Guangxi secret-society rebels and by merit was repeatedly promoted to regional commander, serving under Henan governor Ying Gui's camp.
translations.idiomatic: From the ranks he campaigned against the Guangxi secret-society rebels, rose by merit to regional commander, and served under Henan governor Ying Gui.

sentences.zh: 咸豐八年，英吉利糾合法郎西、米利堅兩國，藉口換約，俄羅斯复陰助之，堅請在京師開議。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Xianfeng England joined France and the United States under the pretext of treaty revision; Russia again secretly aided them and firmly requested negotiations at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Xianfeng (1858) Britain enlisted France and the United States under the pretext of revising treaties; Russia secretly aided them, and all pressed to negotiate in the capital.

sentences.zh: 議未定，艦隊集天津海口，朝命科爾沁親王僧格林沁辦理海防。

translations.literal: Before terms were settled the fleet gathered at the Tianjin sea mouth; the court ordered Prince Senggelinqin of Horqin to manage coastal defense.
translations.idiomatic: Before terms were settled the fleet gathered at Tianjin. The court ordered Prince Senggelinqin of Horqin to manage coastal defense.

sentences.zh: 汝元奉檄至，擢大沽協副將。

translations.literal: Ruyuan received orders and arrived, and was promoted to assistant deputy commander of the Dagu garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Ruyuan answered the summons and was promoted to assistant deputy commander of the Dagu garrison.

sentences.zh: 九年五月，英、法兵船駛入內河，汝元手燃巨砲沉其船，旋中砲歿於陣，諡武愍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the ninth year English and French warships entered the inner river; Ruyuan with his own hand fired a great gun and sank their ship, then was soon killed by cannon in the field and given the posthumous title Wumin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the ninth year (1859) Anglo-French warships entered the inner river; Ruyuan personally fired a great gun and sank one, then was killed by enemy fire and received the posthumous title Wumin.

sentences.zh: 提督史榮椿同死，自有傳。

translations.literal: Commander Shi Rongchun died together with him; he has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Shi Rongchun died with him and has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 是役也，諸國受創甚。

translations.literal: In that campaign the foreign states suffered heavily.
translations.idiomatic: In that fight the foreign powers took heavy losses.

sentences.zh: 十年夏，艦隊复集天津大沽口，提督樂善奉命駐兵大沽，至則以關防交僧格林沁，令所部原留者聽，得千馀人，誓死守。

translations.literal: In the summer of the tenth year the fleet again gathered at Tianjin Dagu; Commander Yue Shan was ordered to garrison Dagu; on arrival he handed his seal to Senggelinqin, let those of his command who had stayed remain, mustered a little over a thousand men, and swore to defend to the death.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the tenth year (1860) the fleet again gathered at Dagu. Commander Yue Shan was ordered to garrison there; on arrival he surrendered his seal to Senggelinqin, kept only those of his force who had remained—about a thousand men—and swore to hold to the death.

sentences.zh: 六月，敵兵自北塘登岸，七月一日，自石縫砲台擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the enemy landed from Beitang; on the first day of the seventh month they were beaten back from the Shifeng battery.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the enemy landed from Beitang; on the first day of the seventh month they were repulsed from Shifeng battery.

sentences.zh: 相持一日，無後援。

translations.literal: They held one day with no rear support.
translations.idiomatic: They held for a day with no reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 火藥局火起，兵多傷死。

translations.literal: The powder magazine caught fire and many soldiers were wounded or killed.
translations.idiomatic: The powder magazine exploded; many soldiers were wounded or killed.

sentences.zh: 樂善知不可守，遂投河死。

translations.literal: Yue Shan knew it could not be held and threw himself into the river and died.
translations.idiomatic: Yue Shan saw the position could not be held and drowned himself in the river.

sentences.zh: 從死者副將、守備各一，失其名。

translations.literal: Those who followed him in death were one deputy commander and one garrison commander; their names are lost.
translations.idiomatic: A deputy commander and a garrison commander died with him; their names are lost.

sentences.zh: 樂善諡威毅。

translations.literal: Yue Shan was given the posthumous title Weiyi.
translations.idiomatic: He received the posthumous title Weiyi.

sentences.zh: 時副將魁霖在通州巡防，檄至天津助戰，亡於陣，諡威肅。

translations.literal: At the time Deputy Commander Kui Lin was on patrol at Tongzhou; ordered to Tianjin to assist, he died in the field and was given the posthumous title Weisu.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Commander Kui Lin was then on patrol at Tongzhou; summoned to Tianjin to fight, he died in battle and received the posthumous title Weisu.

sentences.zh: 委翼長阿克東阿、侍衛扎精阿同死之。

translations.literal: Acting wing commander Akedong'a and bodyguard Zhajing'a died with them.
translations.idiomatic: Acting wing commander Akedong'a and bodyguard Zhajing'a died with them.

sentences.zh: 八月，敵遂北犯通州，圖佔西倉，監督覺羅貴倫與同官玉潤衣冠對縊殉節。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the enemy then invaded Tongzhou to the north, intending to seize the western granary; Superintendent Aisin Gioro Guilun and colleague Yu Run, in full dress, hanged themselves together in martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the enemy pushed north into Tongzhou to seize the western granary; superintendent Aisin Gioro Guilun and colleague Yu Run hanged themselves in full dress.

sentences.zh: 焚淀園，文豐外，員外郎泰清、苑丞泰衷全家自焚死。

translations.literal: When the Garden of Clear Ripples was burned, besides Wen Feng, department director Tai Qing and garden superintendent Tai Zhong and their whole families burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: When the Garden of Clear Ripples was burned, besides Wen Feng, department director Tai Qing and garden superintendent Tai Zhong and their families immolated themselves.

sentences.zh: 時文宗駐蹕熱河，命恭親王奕訢再議款局，而難始定。

translations.literal: At the time Emperor Wenzong was residing at Rehe and ordered Prince Gong Yixin to negotiate terms again, and only then was the crisis settled.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wenzong was then at Rehe; he ordered Prince Gong Yixin to reopen negotiations, and only then did the crisis end.

sentences.zh: 文豐，董氏，內務府漢軍正黃旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Feng, surname Dong, was a Han Bannerman of the Imperial Household of the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Feng, of the Dong clan, was a Han Bannerman of the Imperial Household attached to the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 內務府筆帖式，歷堂主事、員外郎、造辦處郎中，充杭州織造，授驍騎參領。

translations.literal: Clerk of the Imperial Household, he passed through bureau director, department director, and director of the Manufactories Bureau, served as Hangzhou weaving superintendent, and was appointed brave-rider adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: He began as a clerk in the Imperial Household, rose through bureau director, department director, and director of the Manufactories Bureau, served as Hangzhou weaving superintendent, and was appointed brave-rider adjutant.

sentences.zh: 道光二十一年，充粵海監督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Daoguang he served as Guangdong maritime superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Daoguang (1841) he was Guangdong maritime superintendent.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，偕兩廣總督耆英等遵議英吉利五口通商章程十五條，下部議行。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, together with Liangguang governor Qiying and others, he followed deliberation on England's fifteen articles for trade at the five ports and sent them down for discussion and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year (1843), with Liangguang governor Qiying and others, he followed deliberation on Britain's fifteen articles governing trade at the five ports and sent them down for enactment.

sentences.zh: 二十六年三月，授熱河副總管，充蘇州織造。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-sixth year he was appointed Rehe deputy superintendent and Suzhou weaving superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-sixth year (1846) he was appointed Rehe deputy superintendent and Suzhou weaving superintendent.

sentences.zh: 差還，授堂郎中。

translations.literal: On return from assignment he was made bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: On returning from assignment he became bureau director.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年，賞總管內務府大臣銜，歷正藍旗漢軍副都統、正藍旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianfeng he was granted the rank of superintendent of the Imperial Household, and passed through deputy commander of the Plain Blue Han Banner and commander of the Plain Blue guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xianfeng (1854) he was granted superintendent of the Imperial Household, and served as deputy commander of the Plain Blue Han Banner and commander of its guards.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，授總管內務府大臣，尋署正黃旗護軍統領。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year he was appointed superintendent of the Imperial Household and soon acted as commander of the Plain Yellow guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year (1857) he was appointed superintendent of the Imperial Household and soon acted as commander of the Plain Yellow guards.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，管理圓明園事務，調正紅旗滿洲副都統，充崇文門副監督。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year he managed affairs of the Garden of Perfect Brightness, was transferred to deputy commander of the Plain Red Manchu Banner, and served as deputy supervisor of Chongwen Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year (1858) he managed affairs of the Garden of Perfect Brightness, was transferred to deputy commander of the Plain Red Manchu Banner, and served as deputy supervisor of Chongwen Gate.

sentences.zh: 又調正白旗滿洲副都統，署禦藥房、太醫院事務。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to deputy commander of the Plain White Manchu Banner and acted in charge of the Imperial Pharmacy and Imperial Medical Institute.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to deputy commander of the Plain White Manchu Banner and acted for the Imperial Pharmacy and Imperial Medical Institute.

sentences.zh: 十年八月，命在圓明園照料一切事宜，是月英人闖入圓明園，文豐投水殉難。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the tenth year he was ordered to oversee all affairs at the Garden of Perfect Brightness; that month the English broke into the garden and Wen Feng drowned himself in martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the tenth year (1860) he was ordered to oversee all affairs at the Garden of Perfect Brightness; that month the British entered the garden and Wen Feng drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 賜卹如例，贈太子少保銜，入祀京師昭忠祠。

translations.literal: He was granted condolence payments as prescribed, posthumously given the rank of Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and entered the capital's Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Condolence payments were granted as usual, he was posthumously given Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and his spirit tablet was placed in the capital Shrine of Manifest Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，追念忠節諸臣，以「文豐從容赴難，不愧完人」褒之，加恩予諡忠毅。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, recalling loyal martyrs, the court praised him with the words "Wen Feng went calmly to his ordeal and was a man without blemish," and in grace gave the posthumous title Zhongyi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi (1862), when loyal martyrs were remembered, the court praised him as one who "met hardship calmly and without stain," and granted the posthumous title Zhongyi.

sentences.zh: 殷明恆，江西南昌人。

translations.literal: Yin Mingheng was a native of Nanchang, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Mingheng was from Nanchang in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 由武童投效水師營，擢把總。

translations.literal: From military student he entered the naval camp and was promoted to company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service from the military examinations, joined the naval camp, and rose to company commander.

sentences.zh: 光緒四年，赴閩，隸平海中營師船司砲。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Guangxu he went to Fujian and served under the Pinghai Middle Battalion as gunner on the division flagship.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Guangxu (1878) he was posted to Fujian, serving in the Pinghai Middle Battalion as gunner aboard the division flagship.

sentences.zh: 時佛郎西既並越南，將窺滇省，其酋領軍艦十四艘先犯福州，圖覆船政局。

translations.literal: At the time France had already annexed Vietnam and was about to covet Yunnan; its chief led fourteen warships to attack Fuzhou first, intending to destroy the naval shipyard.
translations.idiomatic: France had annexed Vietnam and eyed Yunnan; its commander led fourteen warships against Fuzhou first, aiming to destroy the naval shipyard.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，在馬江發難，明恆陣亡。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year trouble broke out at Mawei; Mingheng died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year (1884) fighting erupted at Mawei and Mingheng was killed.

sentences.zh: 時毀兵船七，商船二，及艇哨各船俱燼，死者不可計。

translations.literal: At the time seven warships, two merchant ships, and all the gunboats and patrol craft were burned; the dead were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Seven warships, two merchant vessels, and every gunboat and patrol craft were burned; the dead were beyond count.

sentences.zh: 見奏報者，以參將高騰雲死最慘，五品軍功陳英戰最烈。

translations.literal: Those named in memorials said brigade commander Gao Tengyun died most horribly and fifth-rank military merit Chen Ying fought most fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: Memorials singled out brigade commander Gao Tengyun for the grimmest death and Chen Ying, holder of fifth-rank military merit, for the fiercest fighting.

sentences.zh: 船廠學生帶揚武艦葉琛，帶建勝艦林森林，均登了台發砲，受彈，猶屹立指揮；

translations.literal: Shipyard students Ye Chen commanding the Yangwu and Lin Senlin commanding the Jiansheng both mounted the deck to fire cannon, were struck, and still stood directing operations;
translations.idiomatic: Shipyard students Ye Chen on the Yangwu and Lin Senlin on the Jiansheng manned the guns, were hit, and still stood directing fire;

sentences.zh: 充福星輪三副王漣受砲傷，猶槍斃敵兵多名，均以傷重陣亡。

translations.literal: third officer Wang Lian of the Fuxing, though wounded by shellfire, still shot down many enemy soldiers and all died of wounds in battle.
translations.idiomatic: third officer Wang Lian of the Fuxing, though shell-wounded, still killed many enemy troops—all died of their wounds in battle.

sentences.zh: 是役也，戰鎮南關外，隸記名提督劉永福部下者，為武監生楊萼恩、哨弁何承文等；

translations.literal: In that campaign, fighting outside Zhennanguan, those under titular commander Liu Yongfu were military student Yang E'en, outpost officer He Chengwen, and others;
translations.idiomatic: In that campaign, outside Zhennanguan under titular commander Liu Yongfu fell military student Yang E'en, outpost officer He Chengwen, and others;

sentences.zh: 隸署提督蘇元春部下者，為總兵孫得勝，副將黃政德、邱福初、陳義新、劉德勝、張大壽、劉玉貴，參將胡延慶、王紹斌、蕭有明、黃世昌、石啟官、張興寬，游擊蕭寶臣、李純五、吳少懷，都司黃均、任有錫、李逢楨、吳述元、周同芳，守備黃效忠、楊承祿，千總蘇全璧、蔣全昌、李得勝，把總王有興、李明德、楊春林、徐國慶、葉亞吉、梁玉輝，外委曹正亮，六品軍功勞國豐，從九品黃汝霖等。

translations.literal: those under acting commander Su Yuanchun were commander Sun Desheng, deputy commanders Huang Zhengde, Qiu Fuchu, Chen Yixin, Liu Desheng, Zhang Dashou, and Liu Yugui, brigade commanders Hu Yanqing, Wang Shaobin, Xiao Youming, Huang Shichang, Shi Qiguan, and Zhang Xingkuan, regional commanders Xiao Baochen, Li Chunwu, and Wu Shaohuai, bureau directors Huang Jun, Ren Youxi, Li Fengzhen, Wu Shuyuan, and Zhou Tongfang, garrison commanders Huang Xiaozhong and Yang Chenglu, battalion commanders Su Quanbi, Jiang Quanchang, and Li Desheng, company commanders Wang Youxing, Li Mingde, Yang Chunlin, Xu Guoqing, Ye Yaji, and Liang Yuhui, staff officer Cao Zhengliang, sixth-rank military merit Lao Guofeng, associate ninth-rank Huang Rulin, and others.
translations.idiomatic: under acting commander Su Yuanchun: commander Sun Desheng; deputy commanders Huang Zhengde, Qiu Fuchu, Chen Yixin, Liu Desheng, Zhang Dashou, and Liu Yugui; brigade commanders Hu Yanqing, Wang Shaobin, Xiao Youming, Huang Shichang, Shi Qiguan, and Zhang Xingkuan; regional commanders Xiao Baochen, Li Chunwu, and Wu Shaohuai; bureau directors Huang Jun, Ren Youxi, Li Fengzhen, Wu Shuyuan, and Zhou Tongfang; garrison commanders Huang Xiaozhong and Yang Chenglu; battalion commanders Su Quanbi, Jiang Quanchang, and Li Desheng; company commanders Wang Youxing, Li Mingde, Yang Chunlin, Xu Guoqing, Ye Yaji, and Liang Yuhui; staff officer Cao Zhengliang; sixth-rank military merit Lao Guofeng; associate ninth-rank Huang Rulin; and others.

sentences.zh: 隸廣西巡撫潘鼎新部下，紙作社之役，為副將蘇玉標，都司陳福隆，把總張元鴻、顧玉芳；

translations.literal: Those under Guangxi governor Pan Dingxin, in the battle at Zhizuoshe, were deputy commander Su Yubiao, bureau director Chen Fulong, and company commanders Zhang Yuanhong and Gu Yufang;
translations.idiomatic: Under Guangxi governor Pan Dingxin, at Zhizuoshe: deputy commander Su Yubiao, bureau director Chen Fulong, company commanders Zhang Yuanhong and Gu Yufang;

sentences.zh: 諒山之役，為提督劉思河，都司劉映谷、黃正寅、鄧晏林、杜光湔，守備羅雲高，千總俞諫臣、蔡得勝、孫其易，把總謝世和，六品軍功萬國發等。

translations.literal: in the Lang Son campaign were commander Liu Sihe, bureau directors Liu Yinggu, Huang Zhengyin, Deng Yanlin, and Du Guangjian, garrison commander Luo Yungiao, battalion commanders Yu Jianchén, Cai Desheng, and Sun Qiyi, company commander Xie Shihe, sixth-rank military merit Wan Guofa, and others.
translations.idiomatic: at Lang Son: commander Liu Sihe; bureau directors Liu Yinggu, Huang Zhengyin, Deng Yanlin, and Du Guangjian; garrison commander Luo Yungiao; battalion commanders Yu Jianchén, Cai Desheng, and Sun Qiyi; company commander Xie Shihe; sixth-rank military merit Wan Guofa; and others.

sentences.zh: 隸福建布政使王德榜部下，戰豐谷等處，為總兵黃喜光，副將胡陽春、武鴻來，參將左廷秀、譚家璐、王得永、蔡玉堂、黃祖富、左占元，游擊陶得玉、聶章壽、王得才、柳臣玖，都司王天喜、陳永發、趙步雲、譚連勝、胡克勝、田玉貴，守備邱正亮、鄧青雲，千總謝廷蘭、張玉魁、楊大德、胡士英，把總蕭恩清、王成吉，外委劉云漢、謝薛昌，六品軍功黎占元、唐復興、譚以明等。

translations.literal: Those under Fujian provincial treasurer Wang Debang, fighting at Fenggu and elsewhere, were commander Huang Xiguang, deputy commanders Hu Yangchun and Wu Honglai, brigade commanders Zuo Tingxiu, Tan Jialu, Wang Deyong, Cai Yutang, Huang Zufu, and Zuo Zhanyuan, regional commanders Tao Deyu, Nie Zhangshou, Wang Decai, and Liu Chenjiu, bureau directors Wang Tianxi, Chen Yongfa, Zhao Buyun, Tan Liansheng, Hu Kesheng, and Tian Yugui, garrison commanders Qiu Zhengliang and Deng Qingyun, battalion commanders Xie Tinglan, Zhang Yukui, Yang Dade, and Hu Shiying, company commanders Xiao Enqing and Wang Chengji, staff officers Liu Yunhan and Xie Xuechang, sixth-rank military merits Li Zhanyuan, Tang Fuxing, and Tan Yiming, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Under Fujian treasurer Wang Debang, at Fenggu and elsewhere: commander Huang Xiguang; deputy commanders Hu Yangchun and Wu Honglai; brigade commanders Zuo Tingxiu, Tan Jialu, Wang Deyong, Cai Yutang, Huang Zufu, and Zuo Zhanyuan; regional commanders Tao Deyu, Nie Zhangshou, Wang Decai, and Liu Chenjiu; bureau directors Wang Tianxi, Chen Yongfa, Zhao Buyun, Tan Liansheng, Hu Kesheng, and Tian Yugui; garrison commanders Qiu Zhengliang and Deng Qingyun; battalion commanders Xie Tinglan, Zhang Yukui, Yang Dade, and Hu Shiying; company commanders Xiao Enqing and Wang Chengji; staff officers Liu Yunhan and Xie Xuechang; sixth-rank military merits Li Zhanyuan, Tang Fuxing, and Tan Yiming; and others.

sentences.zh: 隸福建巡撫劉銘傳部下者，為總兵曾照禮，副將劉義高，千總殷有升，把總尤運農、祁文等。

translations.literal: Those under Fujian governor Liu Mingchuan were commander Zeng Zhaoli, deputy commander Liu Yigao, battalion commander Yin Yousheng, and company commanders You Yunnong and Qi Wen, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Under Fujian governor Liu Mingchuan: commander Zeng Zhaoli, deputy commander Liu Yigao, battalion commander Yin Yousheng, company commanders You Yunnong and Qi Wen, and others.

sentences.zh: 均分別上聞，贈卹有差，高州鎮總兵楊玉科，則以宿將有功，戰歿諒山，自有傳。

translations.literal: Each was reported separately and given posthumous honors in differing degrees; Gaozhou garrison commander Yang Yuke, as an old general with merit, died fighting at Lang Son and has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Each case was reported separately with posthumous honors according to rank; Gaozhou garrison commander Yang Yuke, a veteran with long service, fell at Lang Son and has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 高善繼，字次浦，江西彭澤人。

translations.literal: Gao Shanji, style Cipu, was a native of Pengze, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Shanji, styled Cipu, was from Pengze in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 由附生舉同治元年孝廉方正，朝考用教職，署弋陽縣訓導。

translations.literal: From supplemental licentiate he passed the filial and upright candidacy of the first year of Tongzhi, passed the court examination for educational office, and acted as director of studies of Yiyang County.
translations.idiomatic: A supplemental licentiate, he passed the filial-and-upright candidacy in the first year of Tongzhi (1862), qualified for an educational post in the palace examination, and acted as director of studies at Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 舉優行，皆寒畯士，積弊為清。

translations.literal: He was recommended for excellent conduct; all were poor scholars, and accumulated abuses were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Recommended for excellent conduct, he worked among poor scholars and cleared long-standing abuses.

sentences.zh: 尋調贛州府學教授，又調南安。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to professor of the Ganzhou prefectural school and then to Nan'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to professor of the Ganzhou prefectural school, then to Nan'an.

sentences.zh: 光緒十四年，舉鄉薦，會試不第，謁李鴻章於天津，鴻章，其父執也，語不合，投通永鎮總兵吳育仁幕下。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu he passed the provincial examination but failed the metropolitan; he visited Li Hongzhang at Tianjin—Hongzhang was his father's sworn brother—and when words did not agree he entered the staff of Tongyong garrison commander Wu Yuren.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Guangxu (1888) he passed the provincial exam but failed the metropolitan; he called on Li Hongzhang at Tianjin—Hongzhang was his father's sworn brother—but they did not agree, and he joined the staff of Tongyong garrison commander Wu Yuren.

sentences.zh: 二十年，日本侵朝鮮，廷議主戰。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Japan invaded Korea and court debate favored war.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year (1894) Japan invaded Korea and the court debated war.

sentences.zh: 六月，善繼佐營官駱佩德乘英國高升輪船運送軍實。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Shanji assisted camp officer Luo Peide aboard the British steamer Kowshing transporting military stores.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Shanji assisted camp officer Luo Peide aboard the British steamer Kowshing carrying military stores.

sentences.zh: 駛至牙山口外，日本舉旗招撫，善繼不肯屈。

translations.literal: When they reached the waters off Yalu, Japan raised flags to summon and offer terms; Shanji would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Off the Yalu mouth the Japanese signaled to parley; Shanji refused.

sentences.zh: 管駕英人先逸去，善繼忿極，令懸紅旗示戰備，且進薄之。

translations.literal: The British captain fled first; Shanji was furious, ordered the red flag raised to show readiness for battle, and pressed close.
translations.idiomatic: The British captain fled first. Enraged, Shanji ordered the red battle flag raised and closed with the enemy.

sentences.zh: 方與佩德指揮禦敵，忽船中魚雷，逾時，水勢注射益洶湧，眾強善繼及佩德亟下，善繼奮然曰：「吾輩自請殺敵，而臨難即避，縱歸，何面目見人？

translations.literal: Just as he and Peide were directing defense, suddenly a torpedo in the ship; after a time the water rushed in more violently; the crowd pressed Shanji and Peide to go down at once; Shanji said spiritedly, "We ourselves asked to kill the enemy, and at hardship we flee—if we return, with what face shall we meet men?
translations.idiomatic: As he and Peide directed the defense a torpedo struck; water poured in. Men urged them to abandon ship. Shanji cried: "We volunteered to fight—shall we flee at the crisis? What face would we show if we lived?

sentences.zh: 且吾世受國恩，今日之事，一死而已！

translations.literal: Moreover our family has received the state's grace for generations; today's affair is death, nothing more!
translations.idiomatic: My family has eaten the state's grace for generations—today is a day to die, nothing else!

sentences.zh: 」佩德曰：「如此，吾豈忍獨生？

translations.literal: " Peide said, "If so, how could I bear to live alone?
translations.idiomatic: Luo Peide said: "Then how could I live alone?

sentences.zh: 」高升船遂沉，善繼溺死，佩德從之。

translations.literal: " The Kowshing sank; Shanji drowned and Peide followed him.
translations.idiomatic: The Kowshing sank; Shanji drowned and Peide with him.

sentences.zh: 時護行者為濟遠艦，亦為敵船在豐島襲擊，大副都司沈壽昌堅守砲位，竭力還攻。

translations.literal: The escort at the time was the Jiyuan; it too was attacked by the enemy at Fengdao Island; chief lieutenant Shen Shouchang held the gun position and fought back with all his strength.
translations.idiomatic: The escort was the Jiyuan, also attacked near Fengdao. Chief lieutenant Shen Shouchang held his guns and fought back fiercely.

sentences.zh: 及中砲陣亡，則守備柯建章繼之；

translations.literal: When he was killed by shellfire, garrison commander Ke Jianzhang succeeded him;
translations.idiomatic: When he fell to shellfire, garrison commander Ke Jianzhang took his place;

sentences.zh: 复陣亡，則黃承勳繼之。

translations.literal: when he too died in battle, Huang Chengxun succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: when Ke too was killed, Huang Chengxun succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 與軍功王錫三、管旗劉鶤同與於難，爭趨死地，奮不顧身，尤為當時所稱。

translations.literal: Together with military merit Wang Xisan and flag officer Liu Kun they shared the ordeal, each rushing toward death and heedless of body—especially praised at the time.
translations.idiomatic: With military merit Wang Xisan and flag officer Liu Kun they shared the ordeal, each rushing death without regard for life—especially praised at the time.

sentences.zh: 廣乙快船管輪把總何汝賓，亦於是役中彈陣亡。

translations.literal: Guangyi fast gunboat engineer company commander He Rubin also died by shellfire in that campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Engineer company commander He Rubin of the fast gunboat Guangyi also died by shellfire in that fight.

sentences.zh: 林永昇，福建侯官人。

translations.literal: Lin Yongsheng was a native of Houguan, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Yongsheng was from Houguan in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 入船政學堂肄業駕駛，派兵輪練習，週曆南北洋險要，以千總留閩，充船政學堂教習。

translations.literal: He entered the Naval Shipbuilding School to study navigation, was assigned to warships for training, toured the dangers of the northern and southern seas, remained in Fujian as battalion commander, and served as instructor at the Naval Shipbuilding School.
translations.idiomatic: He studied navigation at the Naval Shipbuilding School, trained on warships, toured northern and southern waters, stayed in Fujian as battalion commander, and taught at the school.

sentences.zh: 復出洋留學，歸，晉守備，調直隸。

translations.literal: He went abroad again to study; on return he was promoted to garrison commander and transferred to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: He studied abroad again; on return he became garrison commander and was transferred to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 從平朝鮮之亂，擢都司。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign to pacify the Korean disturbance and was promoted to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in pacifying Korea and was promoted to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 赴德國接收代造經遠快船，保升游擊。

translations.literal: He went to Germany to receive the Jingyuan fast cruiser built there and was recommended for promotion to regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: He went to Germany to take delivery of the cruiser Jingyuan and was recommended for regional commander.

sentences.zh: 光緒十五年，北洋海軍新設左翼左營副將，以永昇署理。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Guangxu the Beiyang Navy newly established the deputy commander of the Left Wing Left Battalion, and Yongsheng acted in the post.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Guangxu (1889) the Beiyang Fleet created the deputy command of the Left Wing Left Battalion, which Yongsheng held in acting capacity.

sentences.zh: 辦海軍出力，升用總兵。

translations.literal: For exertion in naval affairs he was promoted to commander.
translations.idiomatic: For distinguished naval service he was promoted to commander.

sentences.zh: 二十年八月，朝命海軍護送陸軍赴大東溝登岸援朝鮮，日本海軍來襲，我鐵艦十，當敵艦十有二。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twentieth year the court ordered the navy to escort the army to land at Dadonggou to aid Korea; the Japanese navy came to attack; we had ten ironclads against twelve enemy ships.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twentieth year (1894) the navy escorted troops to Dadonggou to aid Korea; the Japanese attacked—ten Chinese ironclads against twelve enemy ships.

sentences.zh: 副將鄧世昌管帶致遠，都司陳金揆副之；

translations.literal: Deputy commander Deng Shichang commanded the Zhiyuan with bureau director Chen Jinkui as second;
translations.idiomatic: Deputy commander Deng Shichang commanded the Zhiyuan, with bureau director Chen Jinkui as his second;

sentences.zh: 參將黃建勳管帶超勇；

translations.literal: brigade commander Huang Jianxun commanded the Chaoyong;
translations.idiomatic: brigade commander Huang Jianxun commanded the Chaoyong;

sentences.zh: 參將林履中管帶揚威；

translations.literal: brigade commander Lin Lüzhong commanded the Yangwei;
translations.idiomatic: brigade commander Lin Lüzhong commanded the Yangwei;

sentences.zh: 經遠，則永昇主之。

translations.literal: the Jingyuan was commanded by Yongsheng.
translations.idiomatic: the Jingyuan was under Yongsheng.

sentences.zh: 永昇夙與世昌等以忠義相激勵，既合諸艦，衝鋒轟擊，沉日艦三，卒以敵軍船快砲快為所勝，世昌戰歿。

translations.literal: Yongsheng had long with Shichang and others encouraged one another in loyalty and righteousness; once the fleets joined they charged and bombarded, sank three Japanese ships, but in the end were overcome because the enemy's ships were fast and guns fast; Shichang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Yongsheng had long urged one another with Shichang and others to loyalty; the fleets joined, charged, and sank three Japanese ships, but the enemy's faster ships and guns prevailed and Shichang fell.

sentences.zh: 提督丁汝昌坐定遠督船，畏葸不知所為，又被傷，總兵劉步蟾代之。

translations.literal: Commander Ding Ruchang sat aboard the Dingyuan as flagship, was timid and knew not what to do, was also wounded, and commander Liu Buchan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Ding Ruchang on the Dingyuan flagship wavered, was wounded, and commander Liu Buchan took over.

sentences.zh: 船陣失列，有跳而免者，永昇仍指揮艦勇，冒死與戰，驟中敵彈，腦裂死。

translations.literal: The battle line fell out of order; some leaped away to safety; Yongsheng still directed the ship's braves, fought desperately, was suddenly struck by an enemy shell, his brain split, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: The line broke; some jumped clear; Yongsheng still directed his crew, fought on, was struck by a shell, his skull split, and he died.

sentences.zh: 是役也，血戰逾三時，為各國海戰所僅見。

translations.literal: In that campaign the bloody fighting lasted more than three hours—rare in naval battles among the nations.
translations.idiomatic: The bloody fight lasted more than three hours—rare in the annals of naval war.

sentences.zh: 永昇而外，金揆、建勳、履中及守備楊建洛、徐希顏，千總池兆濱、蔡馥，把總孫景仁、史壽箴、王宗墀、張炳福、易文經、王蘭芬，外委郭耀忠，五品軍功張金盛，六品軍功王錫山，均死之。

translations.literal: Besides Yongsheng, Jinkui, Jianxun, Lüzhong, and garrison commanders Yang Jianluo and Xu Xiyan, battalion commanders Chi Zhaobin and Cai Fu, company commanders Sun Jingren, Shi Shouzhen, Wang Zongchi, Zhang Bingfu, Yi Wenjing, and Wang Lanfen, staff officer Guo Yaozhong, fifth-rank military merit Zhang Jinsheng, sixth-rank military merit Wang Xishan—all died.
translations.idiomatic: Besides Yongsheng, Chen Jinkui, Huang Jianxun, Lin Lüzhong, garrison commanders Yang Jianluo and Xu Xiyan, battalion commanders Chi Zhaobin and Cai Fu, company commanders Sun Jingren, Shi Shouzhen, Wang Zongchi, Zhang Bingfu, Yi Wenjing, and Wang Lanfen, staff officer Guo Yaozhong, fifth-rank military merit Zhang Jinsheng, and sixth-rank military merit Wang Xishan—all died.

sentences.zh: 世昌自有傳。

translations.literal: Shichang has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Shichang has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 李大本，安徽六安州人。

translations.literal: Li Daben was a native of Lu'an Prefecture, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Li Daben was from Lu'an in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 咸豐間投效江西軍營，以功累擢游擊，复投效直隸，充哨長，晉副將。

translations.literal: During Xianfeng he entered the Jiangxi army camp; by merit he was repeatedly promoted to regional commander, then entered Zhili service as outpost leader and was promoted to deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the Xianfeng era he joined the Jiangxi army, rose by merit to regional commander, then entered Zhili service as outpost leader and deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十年，日本犯朝鮮，葉志超統軍往援，扼守公州，聶士成率五營駐成歡驛。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Guangxu Japan invaded Korea; Ye Zhichao commanded the army to aid, held Gongzhou, and Nie Shicheng led five battalions stationed at Chenghuan Post.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year Japan invaded Korea; Ye Zhichao led relief forces to hold Gongzhou while Nie Shicheng with five battalions held Chenghuan Post.

sentences.zh: 敵軍來襲，大本與游擊王天培、王國祐同亡於陣。

translations.literal: When the enemy attacked, Daben died in the field together with regional commanders Wang Tianpei and Wang Guoyou.
translations.idiomatic: When the enemy struck, Daben fell with regional commanders Wang Tianpei and Wang Guoyou.

sentences.zh: 時武備學生於光炘、周憲章、李國華、辛得林並赳健士，伏要隘，狙擊敵前鋒，以接應不至，皆死焉。

translations.literal: At the time military students Yu Guangxin, Zhou Xianzhang, Li Guohua, and Xin Delin and other stalwart men lay in ambush at a strategic pass to snipe the enemy vanguard; because relief did not arrive, all died.
translations.idiomatic: Military students Yu Guangxin, Zhou Xianzhang, Li Guohua, and Xin Delin and other stalwarts ambushed the enemy vanguard at a pass; relief never came and all died.

sentences.zh: 士成旋繞渡大同江至平壤與諸軍合，軍無鬥志，潰退相繼。

translations.literal: Shicheng soon crossed the Datong River by a detour to Pingrang to join the armies; the troops had no will to fight and broke and retreated in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Nie Shicheng soon crossed the Datong by a roundabout route to Pingrang; the army had no heart to fight and broke in retreat.

sentences.zh: 獨左寶貴扼險惡戰，死最烈，自有傳。

translations.literal: Only Zuo Baogui held the pass and fought bitterly; his death was the most resolute; he has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Only Zuo Baogui held the pass and fought bitterly to the end—his death was the fiercest; he has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 自是朝鮮無我駐軍，敵遂內犯。

translations.literal: From this there were no more Chinese garrisons in Korea and the enemy then invaded inland.
translations.idiomatic: After that no Chinese troops remained in Korea and the enemy pushed inland.

sentences.zh: 黃祖蓮，安徽懷遠人。

translations.literal: Huang Zulian was a native of Huaiyuan, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Zulian was from Huaiyuan in Anhui.

sentences.zh: 少有志節，嘗思立功異域。

translations.literal: From youth he had resolve and once thought to win merit in foreign lands.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he was high-minded and dreamed of winning merit abroad.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，入上海廣方言館，列優等，送美國遊學。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu he entered the Shanghai Guangzhou Dialect School, ranked in the top class, and was sent to study in the United States.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Guangxu he entered the Shanghai dialect school, ranked first class, and was sent to study in the United States.

sentences.zh: 調天津水師駕駛學堂，旋派赴威遠兵輪練習。

translations.literal: He was transferred to the Tianjin Naval Navigation School and soon assigned to drill on the Weiyuan warship.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to the Tianjin Naval Navigation School and was assigned to train on the Weiyuan.

sentences.zh: 敘千總，署海軍中軍左營守備，充濟遠駕駛二副。

translations.literal: Recorded as battalion commander, he acted as garrison commander of the naval middle army left battalion and served as second navigation officer of the Jiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Rated battalion commander, he acted as garrison commander of the naval middle-army left battalion and second navigation officer on the Jiyuan.

sentences.zh: 海軍出力，以都司升用。

translations.literal: For naval exertion he was promoted to bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: For naval service he was promoted to bureau director.

sentences.zh: 中日釁啟，說丁汝昌以「嚴兵扼守海口，而以兵艦往搗之，攻其不備，否則載勁旅抵朝鮮東偏釜山鎮等處，深溝高壘，絕其歸路，分兵徇朝鮮諸郡邑，彼進則迎擊，彼退則尾追，又出偏師撓之。

translations.literal: When the Sino-Japanese quarrel opened he urged Ding Ruchang: "Hold the sea mouth with strict troops and send warships to strike them, attacking where they are unprepared; otherwise carry crack troops to Pusan and other places on Korea's eastern flank, dig deep trenches and build high ramparts, cut their line of retreat, divide troops to subdue Korea's districts and counties—when they advance meet them, when they retreat pursue, and also send a flanking force to harass them.
translations.idiomatic: When war with Japan opened he urged Ding Ruchang: "Hold the estuary with strong forces and send warships to strike where they are unprepared; or land crack troops at Pusan on Korea's eastern coast, entrench, cut their retreat, divide forces through the Korean counties—meet their advance, pursue their retreat, and harass with flanking columns.

sentences.zh: 彼糧盡援竭，人無鬥志，必土崩瓦解，此俄羅斯破法蘭西之計也。

translations.literal: When their grain is exhausted and reinforcements cut off and men have no will to fight, they will surely collapse like earthworks—this is Russia's plan for defeating France.
translations.idiomatic: When their grain and reinforcements fail and morale breaks, they will collapse—Russia's plan against France.

sentences.zh: 」汝昌不從。

translations.literal: " Ruchang did not follow.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Ruchang would not listen.

sentences.zh: 及大東溝將戰，又說以「海戰宜乘上風，兵法貴爭先著。

translations.literal: When battle at Dadonggou was imminent he again urged: "In naval battle one should take the wind from above; military law prizes seizing the initiative first.
translations.idiomatic: Before the battle at Dadonggou he urged again: "In naval battle take the weather gauge; seize the initiative.

sentences.zh: 今西北風利，宜乘其兵輪未集，急擊不可失」。

translations.literal: Now the northwest wind is favorable; while their warships are not yet gathered, strike quickly and do not miss the chance."
translations.idiomatic: The northwest wind favors us—strike before their fleet assembles; do not lose the moment."

sentences.zh: 汝昌復不決，遂失利。

translations.literal: Ruchang again could not decide and so met defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Ruchang hesitated again and defeat followed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，日人棄西路，南擾山東，祖蓮佐總兵劉步蟾等守威海。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Japanese abandoned the western route and disturbed Shandong to the south; Zulian assisted commander Liu Buchan and others in defending Weihai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Japanese turned from the western front to harass Shandong; Zulian helped Liu Buchan and others defend Weihai.

sentences.zh: 時官軍集關外，東路兵單，日軍由落風港登陸，攻陷榮成，全力萃威海​​。

translations.literal: At the time government troops were massed outside the pass; the eastern route was thin; the Japanese army landed at Luofeng Port, took Rongcheng, and concentrated all strength on Weihai.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops were massed in Manchuria; the eastern front was weak; the Japanese landed at Luofeng, took Rongcheng, and concentrated on Weihai.

sentences.zh: 祖蓮揮將士開砲擊敵，敵少卻，既復大集，諸軍皆潰。

translations.literal: Zulian directed officers and men to open fire on the enemy; the enemy fell back somewhat; when they gathered again in strength all armies broke.
translations.idiomatic: Zulian directed his guns on the enemy, who briefly fell back; when they massed again every unit broke.

sentences.zh: 二十一年正月，道員戴宗騫以力盡援絕投海，越數日，祖蓮與劉步蟾及總兵張文宣、楊用霖等俱死之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year circuit intendant Dai Zongqi threw himself into the sea when strength was spent and relief cut off; a few days later Zulian died together with Liu Buchan and commanders Zhang Wenxuan and Yang Yonglin.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twenty-first year (1895) circuit intendant Dai Zongqi drowned when relief failed; days later Zulian died with Liu Buchan, Zhang Wenxuan, and Yang Yonglin.

sentences.zh: 時汝昌書降於敵，且要敵軍不得殘馀軍，仰藥死。

translations.literal: At the time Ruchang wrote surrender to the enemy and also demanded the enemy army not harm the remaining troops; he took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: Ding Ruchang then wrote surrender to the enemy, demanding they spare the remnant force, and took poison.

sentences.zh: 後以死綏上聞，旨不予卹。

translations.literal: Later, when his death in harness was reported, an edict refused condolence payments.
translations.idiomatic: When his death was reported as dying at his post, the throne refused posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 或謂汝昌實為所部脅降，憤而自盡，降書則死後出洋弁手也。

translations.literal: Some say Ruchang was in fact compelled to surrender by his subordinates, died in rage by his own hand, and the surrender letter was written after death by a foreign petty officer.
translations.idiomatic: Some say subordinates forced his surrender, that he killed himself in shame, and that the surrender letter was drafted after his death by a foreign petty officer.

sentences.zh: 時旅順先陷，海軍掃地，黃海諸要隘皆失守，將士多死事，以奏報有缺，不得書。

translations.literal: At the time Lüshun had already fallen, the navy was swept away, and all key points on the Yellow Sea were lost; many officers and men died for the state, but because memorials were incomplete they could not be recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Lüshun had fallen, the navy was gone, Yellow Sea strongpoints were lost; many died but incomplete reports kept them off the rolls.

sentences.zh: 其見奏報者，三等侍衛永山，在鳳凰城戰歿；

translations.literal: Those who appear in memorials include third-rank bodyguard Yongshan, who died fighting at Fengcheng;
translations.idiomatic: Named in memorials: third-rank bodyguard Yongshan, killed at Fengcheng;

sentences.zh: 游擊李世鴻、副將李仁黨與提督楊壽山分守蓋平，禦敵大將乃木軍，戰最烈，同時以力盡陣亡。

translations.literal: regional commander Li Shihong, deputy commander Li Rendang, and commander Yang Shoushan, who divided defense of Gaiping, resisted the enemy's main force under Field Marshal Nogi, fought most fiercely, and at the same time died in the field when strength was spent.
translations.idiomatic: regional commander Li Shihong and deputy commander Li Rendang with commander Yang Shoushan at Gaiping resisted Field Marshal Nogi's main force in the fiercest fighting and all fell when their strength gave out.

sentences.zh: 步蟾、宗騫自有傳。

translations.literal: Buchan and Zongqi have their own biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Buchan and Zongqi have their own biographies.
